import ctypes
import os


def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load libgslcblas.so globally to resolve BLAS symbols
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    # Load libgsl.so
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl


def compute_hypot(gsl, x, y):
    # Define the argument and return types for the gsl_hypot function
    gsl.gsl_hypot.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_hypot.restype = ctypes.c_double
    # Call the gsl_hypot function
    return gsl.gsl_hypot(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.c_double(y))


def assert_test():
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Test cases
    assert abs(compute_hypot(gsl, 3.0, 4.0) - 5.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert abs(compute_hypot(gsl, 0.0, 0.0) - 0.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert abs(compute_hypot(gsl, 1.0, 1.0) - 1.41421356237) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert abs(compute_hypot(gsl, -3.0, -4.0) - 5.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 4 failed"
    assert abs(compute_hypot(gsl, 6.0, 8.0) - 10.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 5 failed"

    print("All test cases passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
